title: 第九章 天罡游龙手第十章 激战
content_zh:
（）;
read2（）;“嗡”
浑厚的元力从慕容天体内渲泄而出，一股惊人的气势瞬间蒸腾而起！
双眼阴狠之意一闪而逝，慕容天已经决定，他要在最短的时间内以最狠的方式将对面的这个废物踩在脚下。
所以，一出手，便是毫不容情！
“地煞虎贲拳”
“吼”
震天虎吼横空出世，慕容天面色厉然，伴随这道虎吼，他全身上下升腾其一股惨烈的气势，身后猛虎之像将其吞没，仿佛一只隐藏在深山中的斑斓猛虎，突然扑出，出来吃人！
“嗡”
强悍的元力波动席卷整个演武台，慕容天这一出手，立时便显现出其强横之处！
“废物！给我躺下吧！”
慕容天所化斑斓猛虎之像夹带撕裂一切的恐怖力道奔袭到林无缺身前！仿佛在下一刻，林无缺就要被这股力道撕扯的粉碎！
“好强！这慕容天简直强的没边了！”
“这便是凝聚魄月踏入洗凡英魄境所拥有的力量么？”
“只是这第一招，凭废无缺锻体五重天炼筋小成如何能挡？”
慕容子弟惊呼声此起彼伏，此刻他们都被慕容天的强大所震撼。
慕容长青面无表情，心中却暗自一紧。
慕容天有多强，他自然清楚，眼下这第一招，便已然让人侧目，在他的认知当中，这一招，林无缺必败无疑！
不同于慕容长青的面无表情，慕容白石这一刻心中却是冷笑，收拾林无缺这样一个废物，对于他的宝贝孙子来说，犹如碾死一只蚂蚁般简单。
“吼”

感受着慕容天所化斑斓猛虎之像，林无缺这一刻依然长身独立，面色淡然，目光却亮的惊人！
“果然如此，慕容天比我在始古之森一拳逼退的洗凡英魄境的那个修士要强大！”
“但…这有如何？慕容天，今日我必败你于双拳之下！”
“嗡”“哗啦啦”
眼神如刀，林无缺黑发飘扬，大步向前一踏，浑身上下瞬时缭绕起淡金色的元力，圣道战气喷薄而出，金红气血澎湃不休，为他提供源源不绝的浩荡战力！
面对慕容天打出的这一拳，林无缺所选择的便是强势迎击！
不避不让！
他要看看自己此刻比之慕容天，到底如何？或者说，他更要看看成功炼化人级爆灵丹之后的自己，到底强大了多少！
“地煞虎贲拳！”
“吼”
又是一道震天虎吼响彻整个演武场，在众人的目光当中，林无缺同样打出地煞虎贲拳，与身后猛虎之像合二为一，化作一头金色猛虎，刹那间与奔袭而至的斑斓猛虎撞在了一处！
“吼”
“嘭”“嗡”
一白一金两股强悍的元力相击，爆发出惊人的波动，瞬间便淹没了整个演武台！
然而，也就在这一刹，慕容长青和慕容白石脸色皆是大变！
一直静静独立的齐世龙眼中闪过一丝饶有趣味的光芒。
站在齐世龙身后的林璎珞，冰冷的眸子也是一动。
慕容子弟所在的区域中，慕容海双拳紧握，目光紧紧的盯向演武台，心中犹如巨浪翻腾，双目充血！
娇艳的俏脸上划过一丝快意，慕容冰兰心中只剩下一个狠狠地声音：“林无缺！该是你个废物付出代价的时候了！”
就在所有人的目光都集中在演武台上时，一白一金两道元力终于散尽，强横的波动缓缓停滞，两道身影陡然间各自向后退去！

The powerful Yuan Power burst out from Murong Tian's body, and an astonishing momentum instantly evaporated!
The evil look in his eyes flashed away, and Murong Tian had already decided that he would trample this trash under his feet in the shortest time and in the most ruthless way.
Therefore, once you take action, you will be merciless!
"Earth Fiend Tiger Ben Fist"
"Roar"
The sky-shattering tiger roar appeared out of nowhere, and Murong Tian's face was stern. With this tiger roar, a fierce aura rose up all over his body, and the tiger statue behind him swallowed him up, as if a colorful tiger hidden in the mountains suddenly jumped out to eat people!
"Buzz"
Powerful energy fluctuations swept across the entire martial arts stage. Murong Tian's move immediately showed his tyranny!
"Trash! Lie down!"
The colorful tiger statue transformed by Murong Tian rushed in front of Lin Wuque with a terrifying power that could tear everything apart! It seemed that in the next moment, Lin Wuque would be torn to pieces by this force!
"So strong! This Murong Tian is so strong!"
"Is this the power of condensing the soul moon to step into the realm of Xifan Yingpo?"
"It's just this first move. How can I block it with the fifth level of body training and muscle training?"
Murong's disciples screamed one after another. At this moment, they were all shocked by Murong Tian's power.
Murong Changqing's face was expressionless, but his heart was secretly tense.
He naturally knew how strong Murong Tian was. This first move was already attracting attention. In his opinion, Lin Wuque would definitely lose with this move!
Unlike Murong Changqing's expressionless face, Murong Baishi sneered in his heart at this moment. Dealing with a waste like Lin Wuque was as easy as crushing an ant to his precious grandson.
"Roar"
Feeling the colorful tiger image transformed by Murong Tian, Lin Wuque was still tall and independent at this moment, his face was calm, but his eyes were astonishingly bright!
"As expected, Murong Tian is stronger than the monk from the Xifan Yingpo Realm who I forced back with one punch in the Forest of the Ancients!"
"But...what's the matter? Murong Tian, today I will defeat you with both fists!"
"Buzz" and "buzz"
With eyes like daggers, Lin Wuque's black hair was flying, and he strode forward. His whole body was instantly filled with pale golden energy. The fighting energy of the Holy Path spurted out, and the golden-red energy and blood surged endlessly, providing him with an endless supply of mighty combat power!
Facing Murong Tian's punch, Lin Wuque chose to fight back with force!
Don't avoid it!
He wanted to see how he compared to Murong Tian at this moment. In other words, he wants to see how much stronger he has become after successfully refining the human-level explosive spirit pill!
"Earth Fiend Tiger Ben Fist!"
"Roar"
Another thunderous tiger roar resounded throughout the martial arts arena. In the eyes of everyone, Lin Wuque also hit the Earthly Tiger's fist, merged with the tiger statue behind him, and turned into a golden tiger. In an instant, he collided with the colorful tiger that was rushing towards him!
"Roar"
"Bang" "Buzz"
Two powerful forces, one white and one gold, collided and erupted into astonishing fluctuations, flooding the entire martial arts stage in an instant!
However, at this moment, the expressions of Murong Changqing and Murong Baishi changed drastically!
An interesting light flashed in the eyes of Qi Shilong, who had always been quiet and independent.
Lin Yingluo, who was standing behind Qi Shilong, also moved her cold eyes.
In the area where Murong's disciples were, Murong Hai clenched his fists and stared closely at the martial arts stage. His heart was like a huge wave, and his eyes were bloodshot!
A hint of pleasure flashed across her pretty face, and Murong Binglan only had a harsh voice in her heart: "Lin Wuque! It's time you pay the price, you loser!"
Just when everyone's eyes were focused on the martial arts stage, the two yuan forces, one white and one gold, finally dissipated, the tyrannical fluctuations slowly stopped, and the two figures suddenly retreated each other!
